checkpoint: 1 / independent critical contracts before implementation review
scope: Only new reuse-study QA evidence. No old Rama quality record, product source, GLB, import or renderer mutation.

MikkTSpace_gate.required: Official mmikk source commit, exact C/header bytes and retained upstream license; clearly identified local adapter. Checksums/Git blobs verified. A source-library license is not a game-asset grant.

Actual native algorithm callbacks index face/corner data. Output count equals triangle corners and mapping is explicit. Never average discontinuous corner tangents/handedness into a shared source vertex.
MikkTSpace_gate.counterexample: Two adjacent +Z triangles with XY positions [(0,0,0),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(-1,0,0)], UV[(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,0)], indices[0,1,2,0,2,3]. Analytic tangent+X/w+1 on first triangle, -X/w-1 on second; shared source vertices require distinct output corners.

MikkTSpace_gate.required: An independently rotated planar triangle reconstructs the correct UV tangent and handedness within explicit float32 tolerance. Tests must not merely compare the adapter to itself.
Invalid indices, short triangles/rows, nonfinite values, huge float32-overflowing values and unusable normals reject safely before native callbacks or follow a documented non-mutating policy.
counterexamples: finite Python float beyond float32 range
zero normal or invalid normal normalization

MikkTSpace_gate.required: Zero-area geometry and collapsed UV have an explicit reject/marked-fallback contract; no arbitrary basis is mislabeled as recovered UV-correct detail. Mixed valid/degenerate triangles cannot contaminate valid corners.

Actual read-only source diagnosis preserves all GLB bytes and reports per-corner discrepancies without silently applying/averaging tangents. Rendered improvement and final asset promotion remain unrun.

Differentiate current source/fork inspection, old fixture evidence and present provider execution. No current native commercial binary analysis or recovered clients/models without actual accessible inputs and source-bound results.

Per repository distinguish available engine/game code, exact code license, separately licensed demo assets and proprietary original game data. Identify actual code/tool adoption versus conceptual architecture study.
